businesses.name: Liner Legal
businesses.summary: Liner Legal is a disability law firm and ETIB community resource for people exploring Social Security Disability and Long-Term Disability options.
businesses.description: Liner Legal, founded by Michael Liner, provides disability-law information and legal services related to Social Security Disability Insurance, Supplemental Security Income, and Long-Term Disability matters. Liner Legal shared a short eligibility survey with Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. as part of a resource collaboration to help visitors determine whether they may qualify for an initial conversation about disability benefits.
businesses.spokenSummary: Liner Legal is a disability law firm that provides information and legal services related to Social Security Disability, Supplemental Security Income, and Long-Term Disability benefits.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: This listing gives blind and visually impaired people a direct starting point for exploring disability-benefit questions and connecting with a disability-law firm. ETIB shares the resource for information and access; Liner Legal independently handles eligibility review, legal advice, and representation decisions.
businesses.accessibility: Visitors can use the linked online eligibility survey and Liner Legal website to begin. People who need an accessible alternative or communication accommodation should contact Liner Legal directly at (216) 282-1773 or through linerlegal.com.

location.remoteDetails: Online and telephone communication available through Liner Legal.

businesses.name: Access Information News
businesses.summary: Access Information News is a weekly publication covering access information, disability inclusion, accessibility, and technology for disabled communities and professionals.
businesses.description: Access Information News is a weekly access-information publication and newsletter published by Aaron Di Blasi through Mind Vault Solutions, Ltd. It shares news, resources, technology, advocacy, and disability-inclusion stories for people with disabilities, accessibility professionals, organizations, and allies. ETIB is a current pro bono sponsor of Access Information News through its PWD Media Co-op.
businesses.spokenSummary: Access Information News is a weekly publication covering disability news, accessibility, access technology, and inclusion.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: Access Information News helps blind and disabled readers discover access technology, disability resources, advocacy developments, inclusive organizations, and community stories.
businesses.accessibility: The publication is focused on access information and disability inclusion. Readers who need a specific accommodation or accessible communication option should contact the publisher directly.

location.remoteDetails: The publication and newsletter are delivered online, with web-based access and subscription options.

businesses.hours: Weekly publication; contact the publisher by email.

businesses.name: Eyes Like Mine Inc.
businesses.summary: Eyes Like Mine Inc. is a Newark-based nonprofit providing peer support, advocacy, empowerment programs, and community events for blind and visually impaired people.
businesses.description: Eyes Like Mine Inc. is a Newark-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit that empowers blind and visually impaired people through peer support, advocacy, community outreach, education, and inclusive events. Its programs include support groups, Dancing With The Blind, the Ms. Blind Diva Empowerment Pageant, empowerment workshops, volunteer opportunities, and community partnerships.
businesses.spokenSummary: Eyes Like Mine Inc. is a Newark nonprofit that supports blind and visually impaired people through peer support, advocacy, empowerment programs, and community events.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: Eyes Like Mine creates peer connection, advocacy, workshops, events, and empowerment opportunities that help blind and visually impaired people build confidence, community, and visibility.
businesses.accessibility: The organization provides online support-group options and accessible community programming. Visitors should contact the team directly to request accommodations or confirm current event access details.

location.remoteDetails: Online support-group and virtual participation options are listed on the official website; availability may vary.

businesses.hours: By appointment; check the official website for current program and event schedules.

businesses.name: IMperfeKtlymade Foundation
services: Blind and visually impaired fashion shows
businesses.summary: IMperfeKtlymade Foundation empowers blind and visually impaired people through accessible fashion, creative opportunities, community events, and education support.
businesses.description: Founded by Angela Harris, the IMperfeKtlymade Foundation is an Alexandria, Virginia-based nonprofit supporting blind and visually impaired people through inclusive fashion experiences, creative-career opportunities, community events, and advocacy. The foundation produces fashion shows featuring blind and visually impaired models, develops Style Mate, an accessible styling solution, and offers support initiatives including scholarships for legally blind students pursuing creative careers.
businesses.spokenSummary: IMperfeKtlymade Foundation is a Virginia nonprofit that supports blind and visually impaired people through accessible fashion, creative opportunities, fashion shows, and scholarships.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: The foundation creates visible, confidence-building opportunities for blind and visually impaired people to participate in fashion and creative spaces, while also supporting education, community connection, and independence.
businesses.accessibility: The foundation focuses on inclusive fashion and accessible participation for blind and visually impaired people. Contact the organization directly to confirm current event accommodations, application requirements, and registration details.

location.remoteDetails: Online information, applications, and community updates are available through the official website; event participation varies.

businesses.hours: By appointment; check the official website for current program and fashion-show schedules.

businesses.name: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc.
businesses.summary: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community through accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities.
businesses.description: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. supports the blind and visually impaired community by creating accessible media, advocacy, storytelling, and community-centered opportunities that amplify real voices and lived experiences. Through radio, podcasts, educational content, events, and outreach, ETIB promotes visibility, empowerment, inclusion, and leadership while helping reshape how the world understands blind and visually impaired people.
businesses.spokenSummary: Even Though I'm Blind, Inc. is a nonprofit media and advocacy organization empowering the blind and visually impaired community through accessible storytelling, media, outreach, and inclusive opportunities.
businesses.blindCommunitySupport: ETIB creates platforms where blind and visually impaired people can share their experiences, find useful information, build connections, and access opportunities without being framed through pity.
businesses.accessibility: ETIB offers screen-reader-friendly digital platforms, audio-based media, clear communication, and accessibility-centered outreach designed to reduce barriers to information and participation.
